name: Benchmark case
about: Propose a case or report a physics, ambiguity, or scoring issue
title: "[Case] "
assignees: ""
---

## Case ID or proposed topic

If this concerns an existing case, include its stable ID and revision.

## Issue type

- [ ] New case proposal
- [ ] Physics correction
- [ ] Ambiguity or missing assumption
- [ ] Scoring or validator problem

## Scientific issue

Describe the physical setup, observable, and the specific problem or proposed task. Include units, conventions, and assumptions where relevant.

## Expected behavior and evidence

Give a derivation, measurement, or source reference that supports the change. For a scoring issue, include a candidate answer and the expected versus actual verdict.

## Suggested acceptance criteria

What would make the case unambiguous and autonomously scorable?
